title: Four in five vessels talk their way past Bab el-Mandeb
section_path: Four in five vessels talk their way past Bab el-Mandeb
section_path_text: Four in five vessels talk their way past Bab el-Mandeb
summary:
Main
Since the 20 July blockade, four in five tankers passing Bab el-Mandeb are messaging via the AIS destination field to dodge Houthi targeting. By Claire Jungman
Since the July 20 blockade announcement, the AIS destination field has stopped naming a port and started making a case. The messages read as pleas to whoever is watching - but cross-referenced against tracked cargo origin, the vessels with the most to fear mostly aren't the ones sending them.
